title: eval-harness: add per-prompt quality CI gate and metrics integration
author: Ravi Patel
release_notes: Adds a new per-prompt quality gating CI job (eval/prompt-quality) that fails PRs when prompt-level metrics fall below baseline thresholds. Integrates results with eval-metrics service for historical tracking.
description:
Context:
We need stronger guardrails against prompt-set regressions. Current CI surface runs coarse end-to-end evals but misses per-prompt degradations that have caused customer regressions. This PR introduces a per-prompt quality CI gate and ties it to our eval-metrics store so that results are tracked and alertable.

Motivation:
- Catch prompt-level regressions early (before merge)
- Provide actionable output (per-prompt deltas, failing examples) in CI annotations
- Track historical trends in eval-metrics for rollouts/rollbacks

What this change does (summary):
- Adds a new GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/eval-prompt-quality.yml that runs the eval-harness per-prompt suite against the PR model bundle or a pinned baseline. The job uploads detailed JSON and posts annotations for failing prompts.
- Implements a lightweight CLI wrapper (tools/eval_ci/run_prompt_quality.py) that: loads prompt sets, runs the eval harness locally or in CI, computes per-prompt metrics and deltas vs baseline, and exits non-zero when thresholds are exceeded.
- Integrates with eval-metrics client (internal SDK call) to publish run-level aggregates and per-prompt stats to the metrics store for downstream dashboards/alerts.
- Adds baseline artifacts for the nightly reference (tests/data/baselines/prompt_quality_baseline.json) and a script to refresh baselines (tools/eval_ci/refresh_baseline.py).
- Adds unit tests and a smoke workflow to validate the gating logic (eval-harness/tests/test_prompt_quality_gate.py).

Checklist:
- [x] Workflow files for GitHub Actions created and smoke-tested
- [x] CLI wrapper with clear exit codes and machine-readable output
- [x] Integration with eval-metrics client (with soft-fail fallback if the service is not reachable)
- [x] Unit tests covering gating thresholds and annotation formatting
- [x] Docs: short README at eval-harness/ci/README.md describing how to run locally and interpret failures

Commits (high level):
- Add eval-prompt-quality GitHub Actions workflow
- Implement run_prompt_quality.py and refresh_baseline.py
- Add baseline JSON and fixtures
- Wire eval-metrics client integration and telemetry hooks
- Tests and README

Files changed (high level):
- .github/workflows/eval-prompt-quality.yml (new)
- eval-harness/ci/README.md (new)
- eval-harness/tools/eval_ci/run_prompt_quality.py (new)
